spec: Indexed Fibonacci min-heap (Fredman-Tarjan) over ids [0,n): lazy insert, extract-min with consolidation, decrease-key with cut and cascading cut, node pool allocated once at construction, structural accessors (parent_of, degree, is_marked, root_count, cascading_cuts), invariant validator, comparison counter

tests: Fibonacci heap pops in key order after decrease-key
Fibonacci heap consolidates 2^k equal-degree trees into one tree
Fibonacci heap performs a cascading cut when a marked node loses a second child
Fibonacci heap tracks membership, ties and re-insertion
Fibonacci heap works with floating-point keys
Fibonacci heap matches the reference model
